spec_match.rationale: Generates the exact proposed call per selection, distinguishes the Chromium IDL enum (hint/edge/tick/align) from the two explainer-only outcome effects, reproduces the explainer's per-OS mapping table verbatim, and states intensity semantics (system × developer, default 1).

interactive.rationale: Radio effect picker, range intensity, a real playHaptics call button, and a real vibrate() fallback player all drive the code block, timeline, mapping row, and aria-live result.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Card promises call + mapping + audio-free timeline with text equivalents + playable legacy pattern; all four are on the page.

edge_cases.rationale: Explainer-only effects are visibly marked and, when the real API exists, their expected enum TypeError is asserted rather than hidden; the API-absent branch is explicit; the vibrate player surfaces its real boolean; the CSS @haptic half is shown but labelled design-TBD with no fake parse.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5167864517623808, the explainer's vocabulary section, and the design doc's waveform-selection section.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's closed-enum and intensity assertions encode exactly the contracts this tool explains; suite verified executing on /conformance/ (0/8/1 on Chromium 141).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Playwright-driven headless Chromium 141: selected 'error', set intensity 0.5 — call code, 3-bar timeline, and text equivalent all updated; 'Call for real' reported the honest unsupported branch; vibrate([40,60,40,60,40]) executed returning true; zero console errors; screenshots read at both classes.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the load probe, the api-absent fallback, real-call undefined return, the expected enum rejection for explainer-only names, and the vibrate boolean.

design_system.rationale: Tokens only (timeline bars use --accent-blue on --bg-ivory); the primary action is dark-on-ivory with color set; secondary button overrides background and color together; dashed border marks explainer-level options.

accessibility.rationale: Fieldset/legend groups, native radios and range with accent-color, the timeline marked aria-hidden with a full aria-live text equivalent beneath it, mapping as a captioned table, 44px targets; tab order verified: effect radios → intensity → buttons.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: After adding min-width:0 to the grid items (the pre blocks were blowing out the column), measured overflow is 0 at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800; both screenshots read with wrapped effect chips and full-width slider.

openQuestions.title: Verify real haptic effect names and mapping once the explainer stabilizes
openQuestions.detail: The pulse sketches and the hint/edge/tick/align ↔ Hover/Collide/Step/Align mapping mirror today's explainer and design doc. If the vocabulary or platform mapping changes (e.g. success/error land in the IDL, or macOS gains non-generic mappings), refresh the EFFECTS table and the marked explainer-only states.

openQuestions.title: Build a live CSS @haptic concept when a parseable grammar ships
openQuestions.detail: The declarative half is design-TBD, so this page only previews the proposed syntax. Once any build parses @haptic, add a new concept with a real parse probe (CSSStyleSheet.replaceSync round-trip) and interactive trigger demos — as a NEW slug, not a rewrite of this tool.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible radio group fieldset for choosing an option with live preview
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep native radios/range inputs and theme them with accent-color instead of rebuilding custom controls.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Effect picker is native radios in a fieldset and intensity is a native range, both themed via accent-color: var(--accent-blue); no custom widgetry.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel layout without horizontal overflow on narrow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Grid items default to min-width:auto, so wide fixed content (pre/code) can force column overflow; set min-width:0 on grid children.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied .bench > * { min-width: 0 } after the 360px matrix measured 117px of overflow from the pre blocks; re-measured 0 afterwards.

guidanceConsulted.query: text alternative for a purely visual timeline visualization
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Visual-only state needs a text or live-region equivalent; decorative graphics should be hidden from the tree.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The bar track and axis are aria-hidden; an aria-live paragraph renders the same pattern as words (count, strength, duration, intent) on every change.

summary: Configuration/inspection concept: one shared vocabulary driving the exact call, the per-OS mapping, an honestly-labelled illustrative pulse sketch with text equivalents, a real vibrate() comparison player, and the design-TBD CSS half shown without pretending to parse.
